title: Narrow Application-Class Groundwater Head-Accuracy Requirement Qualification Closeout
reason: Independent literature supports defining adequacy from application purpose, decision consequence, prediction uncertainty and temporal-resolution sensitivity, but none of the preregistered narrow classes supplies both a transferable numerical H_app and an independently justified temporal-coupling allocation A_temporal. Therefore no H_budget may be instantiated and no policy VQ may inspect GC02 yet.
important_rejection: The Australian Groundwater Modelling Guidelines statement that iterative convergence should be one or two orders smaller than required head-prediction accuracy is not a temporal-coupling allocation rule and is not reused as A_temporal.

downstream.future_research_condition: Start from a concrete externally governed application with a traceable acceptable decision/prediction error, then independently qualify the mapping to H_app and the allocation to temporal coupling error before any GC02 inspection.

hard_nonclaims: no universal or narrow-class numeric centimetre tolerance
no solver convergence criterion reused as application accuracy
